question: In certain code language, 'FEATURE' is written as 'HICXWVG'. How will 'ALMOST' be written as in that code language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values: 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given code is:
 Alphabets at odd places are increased by 2 positional values.

 Alphabets at even places are increased by 4 positional values.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58db90a5ebdfeff9308326eae772aa24f28b77b72ad331f684c51ba8d52a57ea.png]
